label: Civil aviation (118-137 MHz)
tooltip: Standard civil aviation band: towers, approach, area control.

label: Military VHF (137-144 MHz)
tooltip: Military VHF band adjacent to civil aviation.

label: Military UHF NATO (225-400 MHz)
tooltip:
Harmonized NATO UHF band: air-to-air refueling,
QRA/Baltic Air Policing, exercises.

label: PMR446 (446.00625-446.19375 MHz)
tooltip:
License-free PMR446 walkie-talkies (16 analog channels, NFM).
Very good chance of catching something nearby - popular on
trips, construction sites, at hotels/campsites.

label: Ham 2m (144-146 MHz)
tooltip: 2m amateur radio band (VHF, NFM): repeaters and simplex.

label: Ham 70cm (430-440 MHz)
tooltip: 70cm amateur radio band (UHF, NFM): repeaters and simplex.

label: Marine VHF (156-162 MHz)
tooltip:
Marine VHF band (channels 1-88, including channel 16 - calling/
distress, NFM). Useful near a coast, harbor, or a lake with shipping traffic.

label: FM broadcast radio (87.5-108 MHz)
tooltip:
FM broadcast band (WFM). Not ATC, but strong, always-on stations
make it easy to quickly check the antenna/receiver works correctly.
